title: RemediationAdvice
description: Code-grounded fix guidance for a single finding, produced by reading the actual sink + trace. Distinct from the `fix` stage, which writes a real patch — this is explanatory remediation surfaced inline in the report and viewer.

root_cause.description: Why the bug exists in THIS code — the specific missing guard or unsafe call, naming the real symbols.

recommendation.description: Concrete fix steps grounded in the actual code: name the real function/file, the framework's safe API, and the exact change to make. Not generic advice.

fix_sketch.description: Optional minimal before/after snippet illustrating the change.

code.description: A small illustrative snippet of the fixed code (not a full patch).

references.description: Authoritative links (CWE, OWASP, framework docs) relevant to this fix.
